kitDescription: Biscuit is an Electric rocket-launcher Supporter whose entire kit is team support keyed off the burst rotation. When any Full Burst ends, she gives all Attacker allies +5.77% critical rate on their normal attacks for 10 seconds and trickle-heals them for 10 seconds. Her own Burst II buffs all Supporter allies (including herself) with +43.08% ATK for 10 seconds and lets them recover HP equal to a portion of the damage they deal over the next 10 seconds, while also rebuilding destroyed cover on two allies. Her Skill 2 is a defensive rescue: when a Defender ally drops below half HP she makes them briefly invincible and heals them, twice per battle. She has no damage-dealing skill line of her own.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas. All four load-bearing lines (S1 scoped crit, S1 HoT, burst ATK, burst lifesteal) are FAITHFUL and converge byte-identically across the driver and two independent blind derivations; all three un-fireable/un-representable lines (S2 invincibility, S2 heal, cover rebuild) are DOCUMENTED_GAPs with verbatim records, correct inertness reasoning, and empirical guard tests (S2 board-inert identity; Crown Defender-consumer negative). Discrimination is real on every load-bearing axis: class scope (all-allies counterfactual reaches the whole team where shipped reaches exactly the class subset), normal-vs-generic crit scope (generic critRatePct moves skill/burst buckets, shipped is byte-identical to buff-removed there), trigger identity (fullBurstEnd/burstCast vs fullBurstEnter), liveness (amp/remove counterfactuals move totals), and the heal channel (asuka probe isolates each heal's class scope; the liter-trap guard proves zero Defender leakage). The one fixture hazard — crown out-rotating biscuit at B2 making burst assertions vacuous — was independently caught by the blind author's non-vacuity guard and already handled in the driver's MAIN fixture (crown→ada swap). Residual same-model caveats for owner spot-check: (1) the burst lifesteal's 10-tick stand-in cadence is a documented ⚑ (S6-flagged) that would under-credit a future Supporter on-recovery consumer; (2) biscuit's RL weapon cadence tuple is datamined and footage-unverified (driver caveat), which bounds her minor self-damage; (3) convergence here is cross-agent stability on kit-literal prose, not independent measurement — but per PROVE-IT-DIFFERENTLY the existing pins (driver test 14/14 + adapted blind test green) are the independent labeled check, and the bar is met.
